config.name: Astro Buyer Writing Rules
config.note: Replaces all earlier Buyer rules. Source content is historical, not formal current product/brand signoff.

sharedGlobalFoundation.note: Reference the existing global baseline; buyer-only guidelines are below. Do not copy or enforce Supplier-specific guidelines or glossary.

buyer.label: Buyer
buyer.audience: Buyers using Astro consumer products. Check actual product, journey stage, and audience before applying copy rules.

reviewPolicy.drafts: Historical v0.1.0 draft remains archived; this v0.1.1 file enables test usage, with content subject to review.
reviewPolicy.nonFabrication: Never invent delivery speed, shipping fees, discounts, promos, stock, payment outcomes, urgency or business capabilities.
reviewPolicy.scope: Buyer product UX. Do not automatically apply Buyer capitalization, voice, or marketing tone to Supplier, Mitra, or Admin.
reviewPolicy.pilotApproval: All domain guidelines activated for user-led internal trial on 2026-11-26. Formal policy signoff is not established.
reviewPolicy.scopeNotes: Guidelines are stylistic/research-derived pilot heuristics; do not treat them as evidence of business behavior.
reviewPolicy.legacyWarning: Source is historical playbook; validate current brand, UI, formatting and platform limits. Treat historic delivery, price and personas as background only, never active promises.

toneReference.source: 2.4. Our Tone.pdf; 2.5. Our Tone_ User Journey Map.pdf; 2.6. Writing with Voice & Tone.pdf
toneReference.buyerBaseline: More casual, fun, enthusiastic and simple than operational product tones; adjust to specific situation.
toneReference.journeyNuance: First impressions, onboarding, promo news and payment success may lean more exciting; payment details, confirmation and errors should lean toward respectful reassurance.
toneReference.caution: Tone is context-dependent; payment and errors should never sacrifice clarity or sensitivity for playfulness.

guidelines.name: Voice
guidelines.rule: Friendly, thoughtful and reliable: cheerful, conversational, supportive, humble, universally understandable, direct and knowledgeable. Prefer active voice; jokes and contractions only when context-appropriate.

guidelines.name: Buyer tone
guidelines.rule: Casual, fun, enthusiastic and simple for Buyer; more excitement for first impressions/onboarding/promos/payment success, and more respectful reassurance for payment and errors.

guidelines.name: Voice and tone execution
guidelines.rule: Friendly uses relatable language, thoughtful is comforting and respectful, reliable is positive and clear. Prefer simple phrases, active sentences, modest punctuation; do not overuse emoji or exclamation marks.

guidelines.name: Context
guidelines.rule: Before writing: know why, who reads it, intended message, matching writing angle and CTA.

guidelines.name: Plain language
guidelines.rule: Write conversationally at roughly eighth-grade reading level; short natural sentences (playbook suggests approximately 14–20 words), contractions as appropriate.

guidelines.name: Hierarchy
guidelines.rule: Use clear descriptive headings, logical grouping, short paragraphs and helpful bullets.

guidelines.name: Empathy
guidelines.rule: Lead with benefits to users, anticipate questions and use 'you' or 'kamu' where suitable.

guidelines.name: Editing
guidelines.rule: Read aloud, trim unnecessary words, apply style consistently.

guidelines.name: Abbreviations
guidelines.rule: Prefer full words in body copy where space allows; abbreviations can suit charts/captions. Abbreviated words in body copy take a period, e.g. 'Min.'.

guidelines.name: Acronyms
guidelines.rule: Use familiar acronyms and official entity spellings; explain unfamiliar acronyms on first use and avoid unexplained jargon.

guidelines.name: Capitalization
guidelines.rule: Sentence case for headings and body; Title Case for buttons and section labels in this historical playbook; preserve proper names. Ordinary internet, web, website, email, download, upload, login and logout are lowercase.

guidelines.name: Brand name
guidelines.rule: In product UX copy write 'Astro', not ASTRO (logo styling), astro or aStRo.

guidelines.name: Currency
guidelines.rule: Write Rp50.000 without space or dot; don't abbreviate unless needed. For ranges use Rp on both values and unspaced en dash: Rp50.000–Rp100.000.

guidelines.name: Date
guidelines.rule: Use cardinal dates, three-letter short names without periods, full words in body when useful, unspaced en dash for ranges (Feb 2022–Mar 2022); no ordinal suffixes.

guidelines.name: Time
guidelines.rule: Use HH:MM or HH:MM:SS with timezone, e.g. 06:59 WIB; time ranges with unspaced en dash and WIB once at end.

guidelines.name: Phone numbers
guidelines.rule: Format local as 0851-1234-5678 or international as (+62) 851-1234-5678.

guidelines.name: Units
guidelines.rule: Use numeral with spelled-out unit when room allows (66 kilogram); compact units without spaces (66kg, 66m, 66pcs, 66ml, 66L) when constrained. Decimals rather than fractions for precision; no dot after metric symbols.

guidelines.name: Numbers
guidelines.rule: Use numerals, cardinal numbers in dates, and % symbol (66% not 66 percent).

guidelines.name: Spelling
guidelines.rule: Use American English spelling when writing English, e.g. center, gray.

guidelines.name: Text styling
guidelines.rule: Use bold, italics and capitalization conservatively; emphasize helpful words or phrases, not whole blocks.

guidelines.name: Emoji placement
guidelines.rule: Place emoji at end of title or body copy. Standard notification format: title = summary/hook; body = description + CTA + emoji. Evaluate individual copy components, not whole page text.

guidelines.name: Emoji quantity and frequency
guidelines.rule: Usually use one emoji, unless multiple genuinely suit the message; omit emoji approximately half the time to preserve impact.

guidelines.name: Emoji selection
guidelines.rule: Use the recommended Emoji Set as brand-compatible suggestions, not as a requirement to insert emoji.

guidelines.name: Push notifications
guidelines.rule: Historical guidance: titles 15–30 characters; bodies preferably at most 110 characters; Android may visually truncate sooner. Verify against current platforms before enforcing.

guidelines.name: SMS and release notes
guidelines.rule: Historical guidance: SMS 135 characters, Apple release notes 4000, Google Play release notes 500; verify current limits.

glossary.preferredUsage: Use 'Astro' in UX copy; logo styling may differ.
Preserve proper product naming when relevant; verify current naming.
